zones: the selected card is otherwise authorized to be cast and is represented by a trusted face-pinned CardProgram
objects: phased-in permanents currently controlled by the caster that match the compiled closed Affinity quality's effective-characteristic query union
state_reads: current effective card types, subtypes, supertypes, and token status
costs: each printed represented Affinity instance reduces only the generic component of the spell's total cost by one for each permanent matching its compiled quality union
one permanent matching several branches of the same quality is counted once
the generic component cannot be reduced below zero
timing: the qualifying artifact count is evaluated while determining the spell's payable total cost
hidden_information: the spell remains visible only to seats legally entitled to see its origin zone until casting makes it public
the reduction reads only public battlefield characteristics
layers: quality matching comes from the canonical current effective-characteristic query
dynamic type-changing interactions use that same cycle-safe boundary
layer-6 addition or removal of Affinity itself remains outside this slice until the shared ability-applicability query exists
replacement_effects: cost-payment replacement effects are outside this bounded family and fail closed
copy: a copied spell was not cast and does not use Affinity
control_change: only artifacts currently controlled by the caster contribute
zone_change: only permanents currently present on the battlefield contribute
source_leaves: the spell's selected face and compiled descriptor are revalidated before payment

variants: closed type, subtype, supertype, token, outlaw, snow-land, and historic-permanent qualities
multiple printed instances apply independently and cumulatively
qualities outside the closed grammar, dynamically granted or removed Affinity, and Affinity-equivalent rules text remain unsupported

implementation.supported_slice: Printed Affinity for one closed compiler quality on the selected cast face, evaluated over current effective controlled phased-in permanents through canonical object queries.

known_blockers: Affinity qualities outside the closed compiler grammar
granted, copied, removed, or text-changed Affinity until one shared ability-applicability query exists
unrepresented cost-payment replacements, restrictions, and total-cost ordering interactions
